description: Accept the creator’s own funded assignment and start its work deadline. Call only after the creator explicitly confirms acceptance of the frozen terms; the creator receives B/Fc/N only. Requires confirm:true and write scope. Creator-facing DTOs include only the creator’s own B/Fc/N and own outcome amounts. Every creator offer carries: “Сумма заказа заморожена на платформе до приёмки работы рекламодателем”.

confirm.description: Required confirmation: call only after the human explicitly approved this action.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable UUID for this command. Reuse the same UUID if its outcome is unknown.

name: vibevo_accept_placement_assignment
